**Ingredients:**

- ¼ cup melted butter
- 1 cup sugar, divided
- 3 (8 oz) packages cream cheese, softened
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 eggs

**Equipment:**
- 9-inch springform pan
- Mixing bowl
- Mixer

3. Bake 55 mins or until set. Cool, then refrigerate 4 hours.
